tools.name: searchanise_search
tools.description: Search the store's products with Searchanise, as the Search Results Widget does. Returns product ids, titles, links, prices, quantities and images; optionally matching categories and pages, and filter facets. restrict_by filters by attribute. For text attributes: | is OR, a comma is AND, ! is NOT, a

tools.name: searchanise_autocomplete
tools.description: Get what the Instant Search Widget shows while a shopper types: query suggestions, the top matching products, and optionally categories and pages. Search API: GET /getwidgets with suggestions=true.

tools.name: searchanise_get_index_status
tools.description: Get the store's index state: status (none, update, updating, normal, error or disabled), full_import (start or done) and product_count. Use it to check whether the latest product data is indexed. State API: GET /api/state/get/json.

tools.name: searchanise_delete_product
tools.description: Remove one product from the Searchanise search index by its numeric id. It does not delete the product from the store, and it cannot be undone from here (re-import the product to restore it). Searchanise applies the delete after indexing, which takes some minutes. tools.name: searchanise_delete_category
tools.description: Remove one category from the Searchanise search index by its numeric id. It does not delete the category from the store, and it cannot be undone from here. Searchanise applies the delete after indexing, which takes some minutes. The store's own catalog is not changed. Update API: POST /api/categorie

tools.name: searchanise_delete_page
tools.description: Remove one page from the Searchanise search index by its numeric id. It does not delete the page from the store, and it cannot be undone from here. Searchanise applies the delete after indexing, which takes some minutes. The store's own catalog is not changed. Update API: POST /api/pages/delete/json

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: searchanise_delete_product, searchanise_delete_category, searchanise_delete_page · Public sink: searchanise_delete_product, searchanise_delete_category, searchanise_delete_page · Destructive: searchanise_delete_product, searchanise_delete_category, searchanise_delete_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: searchanise_delete_product, searchanise_delete_category, searchanise_delete_page · Public sink: searchanise_delete_product, searchanise_delete_category, searchanise_delete_page · Destructive: searchanise_delete_product, searchanise_delete_category, searchanise_delete_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
